# DSH Work

> Status: foundation phase as of 2026-08-14. No production-ready release is available.

DSH Work is an independent, local-first office agent workspace built on
DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It is intended to turn project sources into reviewable
and editable deliverables such as reports, spreadsheets, and presentations.

Core workflow: project sources -> specialized agent roles -> draft deliverable
-> citation and change review -> human approval -> export or external action.

DSH Work is not an official DeepSeek product, is not a replacement for
Microsoft Office, and does not currently ship a stable desktop application.

Primary source: https://github.com/HuangYuChuh/dsh-work

Documentation:
- README: https://github.com/HuangYuChuh/dsh-work#readme
- Architecture: https://github.com/HuangYuChuh/dsh-work/blob/main/docs/architecture.md
- Product positioning: https://github.com/HuangYuChuh/dsh-work/blob/main/docs/product-positioning.md
- SEO and GEO policy: https://github.com/HuangYuChuh/dsh-work/blob/main/docs/seo-geo.md

Key terms: DeepSeek Harness office agent, DSH office workflow, local-first
office agent workspace, sources-to-deliverables, cited deliverables, human
approval, agent presets, plugins, workflows, subagents.
